learn: Horizontal and vertical lines.
Parallel and perpendicular lines.
Draw shapes on a dotted grid.

practise.q: A line that is like the horizon — flat across is called…
practise.h: Think of railway tracks (parallel) and a plus sign (perpendicular).

practise.q: How many pairs of parallel sides does a triangle have?
practise.h: Look for opposite sides that never meet.

practise.q: Does the capital letter E have parallel lines?
practise.h: Parallel lines never meet; perpendicular lines meet at a right angle.

practise.q: A line that is straight up and down is called…

practise.q: How many pairs of parallel sides does a rectangle have?

practise.q: Does the capital letter H have parallel lines?

practise.q: Does a right-angled triangle have any perpendicular sides?
practise.h: Perpendicular sides meet at a right angle.

practise.q: Does the capital letter V have perpendicular lines?
practise.h: Parallel lines never meet; perpendicular lines meet at a right angle.

practise.q: Does the capital letter N have parallel lines?
practise.h: Parallel lines never meet; perpendicular lines meet at a right angle.

practise.h: Parallel lines never meet; perpendicular lines meet at a right angle.

practise.q: How many pairs of parallel sides does a trapezium have?
practise.h: Look for opposite sides that never meet.

practise.q: Does a equilateral triangle have any perpendicular sides?
practise.h: Perpendicular sides meet at a right angle.

practise.q: Does a square have any perpendicular sides?
practise.h: Perpendicular sides meet at a right angle.

practise.q: How many pairs of parallel sides does a square have?
practise.h: Look for opposite sides that never meet.

practise.q: Does a regular octagon have any perpendicular sides?
practise.h: Perpendicular sides meet at a right angle.

practise.q: Which word means lines that meet at a right angle?
practise.h: Think of railway tracks (parallel) and a plus sign (perpendicular).

practise.q: How many pairs of parallel sides does a parallelogram have?
practise.h: Look for opposite sides that never meet.

practise.q: Does the capital letter F have perpendicular lines?
practise.h: Parallel lines never meet; perpendicular lines meet at a right angle.
